facts.business: JNK India Limited is a leading Indian company in combustion equipment, offering process-fired heaters and extending into clean energy opportunities through JNK Chemdist Technologies.
facts.related_party_note: Loans and guarantees to subsidiaries: aggregate granted during year Rs 305.50 cr loans and Rs 250.00 cr guarantees; outstanding Rs 324.72 cr loans and Rs 250.00 cr guarantees. Also loans to employees Rs 8.96 cr granted, Rs 4.09 cr outstanding. Corporate guarantee is joint and several with two directors of subsidiary.
